pages.title: CodePath – Learn Web Development Online
pages.html:
💻 CodePath

Learn Web Development Online

Master HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React with hands-on projects. Start your coding journey today.

Why Choose CodePath?

Expert Instructors

Learn from experienced developers working at leading tech companies with years of industry expertise.

Hands-On Projects

Build real-world applications and portfolio projects that showcase your skills to potential employers.

Flexible Learning

Study at your own pace with lifetime access to course materials and community support.

Course Curriculum

Our comprehensive curriculum covers everything you need to become a proficient web developer.

1 HTML Fundamentals

Learn the building blocks of the web. Master semantic HTML5, forms, accessibility standards, and best practices for structuring web content.

  • HTML5 structure and elements
  • Forms and input validation
  • SEO and semantic markup
  • Web accessibility (WCAG)
2 CSS Styling & Layout

Create beautiful, responsive designs. Learn CSS fundamentals, Flexbox, Grid, animations, and responsive design techniques.

  • CSS selectors and specificity
  • Flexbox and CSS Grid layouts
  • Responsive design and media queries
  • Animations and transitions
3 JavaScript Essentials

Master the language of the web. Learn variables, functions, DOM manipulation, events, and modern ES6+ features.

  • Variables, data types, and operators
  • Functions and scope
  • DOM manipulation and events
  • ES6+ features and async/await
4 React & Components

Build modern web applications with React. Learn components, hooks, state management, and best practices.

  • React components and JSX
  • Hooks and state management
  • Props and component communication
  • React Router and API integration
5 Backend Basics

Understand server-side development. Learn Node.js, Express, databases, and API design principles.

  • Node.js and Express.js
  • RESTful API design
  • Database fundamentals (SQL and NoSQL)
  • Authentication and security
6 Portfolio & Deployment

Launch your career. Build a professional portfolio, deploy applications to the web, and prepare for job interviews.

  • Building portfolio projects
  • Git version control and GitHub
  • Hosting and deployment (Heroku, Vercel)
  • Interview preparation and job search
